why: No page for this route was found, so the glacier question stays open.
The area page says to rope on both glaciers, but nothing describes this line or its descent as off crevassed ice.
A trip report shows a snow ramp climbed with an axe and a shrunken remnant glacier beside the col, but no crevasse hazard is described either way.
No page for the route was found and the Rundle page read says nothing about glaciers.
The Stanley Glacier is crossed to reach the north face routes, with seracs on the way and crevasse rescue advised, and this route starts once on the glacier.
